questions.stem: 對想回饋社會的人來說，志工旅遊（voluntourism）結合了旅行與服務，這正是它日益流行的原因。
questions.answer: For those who want to contribute to society, voluntourism combines travel with volunteer work, which is why it is increasingly popular.
accepted_answers: For those who wish to give back to society, voluntourism combines traveling and volunteering, which explains why it is becoming more and more popular.
For those who hope to give something back to society, voluntourism brings together travel and service, which is exactly why it is growing in popularity.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（, which is why …）

questions.stem: 然而，短期志工為當地社區蓋的學校，往往在他們離開後因缺乏維護而被棄置。
questions.answer: However, the schools that short-term volunteers build for local communities are often abandoned after the volunteers leave due to a lack of maintenance.
accepted_answers: However, the schools which short-term volunteers build for local communities are often left unused after they leave because of a lack of maintenance.
However, the schools that short-term volunteers put up for local communities are often abandoned once they leave, as no one maintains them.

1.explanation_zh: 「對…的人來說」用 For those who + V …（those 指「那些人」，後面接 who 子句）；「回饋社會」是 give back to society／contribute to society。「結合 A 與 B」用 combine A with B（或 combine A and B）。句尾「這正是它日益流行的原因」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 , which is why it is increasingly popular（which is why＝這就是為什麼）。「志工旅遊」題目已附英文 voluntourism。
evidence: 對想回饋社會的人來說
這正是它日益流行的原因
1.strategy_zh: 「對…的人來說」→ For those who + V；「這正是…的原因」接在句尾 → , which is why + S + V。
hints: 切成四段：對想回饋社會的人來說／志工旅遊結合了旅行與服務／這正是／它日益流行的原因
標的詞彙：contribute／give back（回饋）、society（社會）、combine（結合）、travel（旅行）、service（服務）、popular（流行的）
句型框架：For those who + V …, S + combines A with B, which is why + S + V …

2.explanation_zh: 主詞是「學校」，修飾語「短期志工為當地社區蓋的」改成關係子句 the schools that short-term volunteers build for local communities（that 是受格關代，可省略）。學校是「被」棄置，用被動 are (often) abandoned／are left unused。「在他們離開後」用 after the volunteers leave（時間子句用現在式）；「因缺乏維護」用 due to／because of a lack of maintenance。
evidence: 短期志工為當地社區蓋的學校
2.strategy_zh: 先找出真正的主詞（學校）和主要動詞（被棄置），英文主詞＋動詞先寫，時間、原因放後面。
hints: 切成四段：然而，短期志工為當地社區蓋的學校／在他們離開後／因缺乏維護／而被棄置（英文順序：學校＋被棄置＋離開後＋原因）
標的詞彙：short-term（短期的）、volunteer（志工）、build（建造）、community（社區）、leave（離開）、lack（缺乏）、maintenance（維護）、abandon（棄置）
句型框架：However, the + N + that + S + V … + are often p.p. + after … + due to a lack of + N

references: For those who want to contribute to society, voluntourism combines travel with volunteer work, which is why it is increasingly popular.
For those who wish to give back to society, voluntourism combines traveling and volunteering, which explains why it is becoming more and more popular.
For those who hope to give something back to society, voluntourism brings together travel and service, which is exactly why it is growing in popularity.

patterns.label_zh: 對於…的人而言（For those who）
patterns.frame: For those who + V …, S + V …
patterns.zh_trigger: 對想回饋社會的人來說

patterns.label_zh: 非限定關係子句（, which is why …）
patterns.frame: S + V …, which is why + S + V …
patterns.zh_trigger: 這正是它日益流行的原因

parts.zh: 對想回饋社會的人來說
accepted: For those who want to contribute to society
For those who wish to give back to society
For those who hope to give something back to society
For those who want to give back to society

common_errors.wrong: For those want to contribute to society
common_errors.right: For those who want to contribute to society
common_errors.explanation_zh: those 後面要用 who 引導子句（those who + V），who 不能省略。

common_errors.wrong: For those who want to feedback society
common_errors.right: For those who want to give back to society
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「回饋社會」是 give back to society／contribute to society；feedback 是名詞「意見回饋」。

accepted: voluntourism combines travel with volunteer work
voluntourism brings together travel and service

common_errors.explanation_zh: and 前後要對等：travel（名詞）配 service（名詞），或 traveling 配 volunteering。

common_errors.wrong: voluntourism combine travel with volunteer work
common_errors.right: voluntourism combines travel with volunteer work
common_errors.explanation_zh: 主詞 voluntourism 是單數，動詞加 s。
逗號後面用 this 會變成兩個句子硬接；用 which 指前面整件事：which is why …。

common_errors.wrong: which is the reason why that
common_errors.explanation_zh: the reason why 和 that 不要同時用；寫 which is why 最簡潔。

accepted: it is becoming more and more popular

common_errors.wrong: it is more and more popularity
common_errors.right: it is becoming more and more popular
common_errors.explanation_zh: be 動詞後面接形容詞 popular；popularity 是名詞（grow in popularity）。
popular 是形容詞，前面要有 be 動詞；副詞 increasingly 放在形容詞前面。

traps.literal_error: For those who want to feedback the society, voluntourism …
traps.explanation_zh: 「回饋社會」是把自己得到的回報給社會，用 give back to society 或 contribute to society；feedback 是名詞，意思是「意見回饋」。

traps.literal_error: …, which is why it is more and more popularity.
traps.explanation_zh: 「流行」在 be 動詞後面要用形容詞 popular；名詞 popularity 要搭配 grow in popularity。

bonus.text: For those eager to give back, voluntourism blends travel with service, which accounts for its growing popularity.
bonus.explanation_zh: those eager to …（省略 who are）、blend … with …（融合）、which accounts for（這說明了）讓句子更精簡。

1.restructuring_zh: 「這正是它日益流行的原因」不要譯成 This is the reason … 另起一句，改成 , which is why it is increasingly popular，把「原因」轉成 why 子句。

references: However, the schools that short-term volunteers build for local communities are often abandoned after the volunteers leave due to a lack of maintenance.
However, the schools which short-term volunteers build for local communities are often left unused after they leave because of a lack of maintenance.
However, the schools that short-term volunteers put up for local communities are often abandoned once they leave, as no one maintains them.

patterns.label_zh: 關係代名詞 that 引導的形容詞子句（受格，可省略）
patterns.zh_trigger: 短期志工為當地社區蓋的學校

parts.zh: 然而，短期志工為當地社區蓋的學校
accepted: However, the schools that short-term volunteers build for local communities
However, the schools which short-term volunteers build for local communities
However, the schools that short-term volunteers put up for local communities
However, the schools short-term volunteers build for local communities

common_errors.wrong: However, short-term volunteers build schools for local communities
common_errors.right: However, the schools that short-term volunteers build for local communities
common_errors.explanation_zh: 這一句的主詞是「學校」，「短期志工為當地社區蓋的」是修飾語，要寫成 the schools that … build；照中文順序寫會變成志工當主詞，後面的「被棄置」接不上。

common_errors.wrong: the schools that short-term volunteers build them
common_errors.right: the schools that short-term volunteers build
common_errors.explanation_zh: that 已經代替受詞 schools，子句裡不可再寫 them。
時間副詞子句用現在式代替未來式。
after 後面接子句要有完整的動詞：after they leave。

accepted: due to a lack of maintenance
because of a lack of maintenance

common_errors.right: because of a lack of maintenance
common_errors.explanation_zh: because 後面接子句；接名詞片語要用 because of／due to。

common_errors.right: due to a lack of maintenance
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「缺乏維護」是名詞片語 a lack of maintenance；maintain 是動詞。
學校是「被」棄置，要用被動語態 be + p.p.。
現在式被動是 are abandoned，are 和 been 不能同時用。

traps.literal_error: … are often abandoned after the volunteers leave due to lack maintain.
traps.explanation_zh: 「維護」在這裡是名詞，due to 後面接名詞片語 a lack of maintenance；寫成動詞 maintain 是詞性錯誤。

traps.zh: 短期志工為當地社區蓋的學校
traps.literal_error: However, short-term volunteers built for local communities schools are often abandoned …
traps.explanation_zh: 「…蓋的學校」中文修飾語在前；英文先寫 the schools，再接 that short-term volunteers build for local communities。

bonus.text: However, many schools hastily built for local communities by short-term volunteers end up abandoned once the volunteers depart, with no one left to maintain them.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用分詞片語 hastily built by …、end up + p.p.（最後落得…）和 with no one left to …（附帶狀況）把原因說得更生動。

2.restructuring_zh: 中文把「被棄置」放在句尾，英文要把主要動詞 are often abandoned 緊接在主詞後面，再接 after … 與 due to …；主詞「…蓋的學校」改成 the schools that … build。

1.translation: For people who want to give back to society, voluntourism combines travel with service, which is exactly why it has become increasingly popular.
1.explanation_zh: 「想回饋社會的人」用關係子句與片語 give back to society；「結合了」譯 combines A with B；「這正是……的原因」用非限定關係子句 which is exactly why；「日益流行」用現在完成式 has become increasingly popular。

2.translation: However, the schools that short-term volunteers build for local communities are often abandoned due to a lack of maintenance after the volunteers leave.
2.explanation_zh: 「短期志工為當地社區蓋的學校」用關係子句；「被棄置」用被動 are abandoned；「因缺乏維護」譯 due to a lack of maintenance；「在他們離開後」用 after 子句，主詞寫明 the volunteers，避免 they 被誤解為指學校。

issues_zh: 建議（不影響判定）：第 1 部分可補「For people who want to give back to society」，第 2 部分可補「combines travel with service」。
建議（不影響判定）：參考譯文 1、2 的 after/once they leave 中 they 在文法上最近的先行詞是主詞 the schools，雖然語意上不會誤解，超越頂標的示範譯文寫成 the volunteers（如參考譯文 0）較清楚。

1.translation: For people who want to give back to society, voluntourism combines travel with service, which is exactly why it is becoming increasingly popular.
1.explanation_zh: 「回饋社會」用 give back to society；「結合了旅行與服務」用 combine A with B；「這正是……的原因」用 which is exactly why 帶出結果；「日益流行」用 become increasingly popular 的進行式。

2.translation: However, the schools that short-term volunteers build for local communities are often abandoned after the volunteers leave because of a lack of maintenance.
2.explanation_zh: 「蓋的學校」用關係子句修飾 schools；「被棄置」用被動 be abandoned；「離開後」用 after the volunteers leave 以免 they 指代不明；「因缺乏維護」用 because of a lack of maintenance。bulid 與 abandon 的詞選擇無疑問，信心稍降是因為副詞片語位置有兩種寫法。

issues_zh: 輕微：我寫 For people who 而不是 For those who，並且把 combines travel with service、is becoming increasingly popular 這些可接受寫法重新組合，逐字不在 accepted 清單內，但結構與語意都落在可接受範圍；accepted 逐一列舉的做法對這類重組比較脆弱。
